reference_sql:
SELECT o.order_id,
       s.store_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_stored_eur,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur / 100 - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_fixed_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * p.unit_cost_eur
GROUP BY o.order_id, s.store_code
ORDER BY o.order_id

SELECT o.order_id,
       s.store_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_stored_eur,
       SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price_eur / 100) - ol.line_discount_eur) AS revenue_fixed_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE ol.unit_price_eur > 10 * (SELECT p.unit_cost_eur FROM products AS p WHERE p.product_id = ol.product_id)
GROUP BY o.order_id, s.store_code
ORDER BY o.order_id
